title: Accelerated Skilled Worker Procedure
subtitle: A special process developed to accelerate the immigration and recognition process for skilled workers coming from abroad. This process is designed to minimize bureaucratic barriers and expedite permits.
employerInitiation: Employer Initiation - The process is initiated and coordinated by the employer throughout
qualificationRecognition: Qualification Recognition - Foreign qualifications are quickly assessed and recognized
comprehensiveSupport: Comprehensive Support - Employer takes over most of the application process
